OAT-05/S26.detail: Our own spec (no dependency on the broken ARGS registry): 26 actions declared in convex/ai, all 26 refused for a caller with no session, every refusal 'ConvexError: Not authenticated at requireUserId (convex/lib/auth.ts) at handler (convex/lib/phi.ts)', i.e. before any provider; transcribe.transcribeAudio and transcribe.prepareSession included; voicefix.extractPatientDetails called with our own args.
